programs.name: BEZ CAM
programs.description: Beginner-friendly CAM: a SolidWorks-style program that turns a part into Fanuc G-code. Mill only for now.
programs.note: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Installs just for you, no admin needed, and sets itself up the first time it starts. If Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway.

images.alt: Make G-code's first question, which side faces up, with the part sitting in its stock
A sample block with a pocket and two holes open on the Features tab

programs.name: G-Code Trainer
programs.description: Learn CNC programming from zero on FANUC-style mills and lathes. 59 guided lessons (33 mill, 26 lathe), each with a quiz and a hands-on coding exercise you run in a live 2D/3D simulator. 158 quiz questions, 40 blueprint part challenges, working FANUC 0i-MF and 0i-TF control-panel simulators, a reference for 46 G-codes, 13 M-codes and 52 alarms, and a live checker that catches 62 kinds of mistakes.
programs.note: Teachers get a class roster with per-student progress and CSV export. Mac: pick Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

programs.name: BEZ GPAD
programs.description: G-code notepad with a “spell checker” for Fanuc mill and lathe code: errors underline red, warnings yellow, with one-click fixes. The Code Wizard on the side writes hole cycles, tool changes, threads and grooves from a few boxes, starting from the tool and speed already at the cursor.

programs.name: JIG
programs.description: Tightens up a song's beat timing: finds the beats and stretches the mix (or its stems) onto a steady grid, with a before/after tightness score and WAV export.

programs.name: HONE
programs.description: Audio mastering app inspired by iZotope: Assist to a target loudness, Match EQ against reference tracks, album mode, clipper, EQ and limiter, with MP3 export.

programs.name: CHIPLOAD
programs.description: Machinist calculator: speeds and feeds, tap drills, threads, bolt circles and more, with a “How was this figured?” breakdown on every result. Works offline.

programs.name: BEZ InPrints
programs.description: An offline trainer for reading welding prints (AWS A2.4:2020) and machine prints with GD&T (ASME Y14.5-2018). It has 100 short lessons, 30 full shop prints to read against the clock, a symbol builder, 3D views of welds and tolerance zones, and practice cert tests. For welders, machinists, apprentices, and anyone studying for a print-reading test.
programs.note: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Installs just for you, no admin needed. If Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway. Mac: one download for Intel and Apple Silicon. The first time, try to open it, then go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.

images.alt: BEZ InPrints home screen with rank, welding and machinist progress
A Print Challenge: a full welding shop print with the question beside it
Symbol Builder reading a welding symbol in plain English
An angularity tolerance zone shown in 3D

programs.name: BEZ MaPPer
programs.description: Manufacturing process planner for machined parts. A step-by-step wizard asks about the part (shape, size, material, features, machines) and builds the process plan, with setup sheets and inspection plans you can print.
programs.note: Reading drawings is optional and uses your own Anthropic API key.

programs.name: LearnLinux+
programs.description: Learn Linux from zero in a simulated shell that never touches your real PC: 62 lessons, 185 quiz questions and a scored practice exam, built around the CompTIA Linux+ XK0-005 objectives (the exam version before today's XK0-006).
programs.note: Mac: needs Python 3.10 or newer (free from python.org). Unzip and double-click Start LearnLinux+. Tab completion is Windows-only.

programs.name: HackPath
programs.description: Learn ethical hacking from zero: 29 lessons over 7 tracks, aligned to CompTIA PenTest+. Practice targets run in sealed local Docker containers with no internet access.
programs.note: Needs Docker Desktop. The first run needs internet to download the practice containers. Mac: needs Python 3.11 or newer (free from python.org); unzip and double-click Start HackPath.

programs.name: Shoot The Shit
programs.description: A physics siege shooter: blast drones out of brick, glass and concrete towers with as few rounds as you can. 24 levels across 4 sectors, 6 ammo types, craters and collapsing towers, plus Siege, Demolition and a tower Workshop.
programs.note: Windows: installs just for you, no admin needed; if Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway. Mac: one download for Intel and Apple Silicon; the first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help). Android: allow installs from unknown sources when asked. The browser version plays best in landscape.

images.alt: A shell blast tearing through a brick tower with drones inside
Collapsing towers on the skyline level
The title screen with Play, Levels, Modes and Armory
The Modes screen: Siege, Demolition and the Workshop

programs.name: Nowhere to Hide
programs.description: Single-player extraction FPS on a tiny spherical planet, where the curve of the horizon tells you how far away an enemy is. Grab loot and reach the beacon before the hunters close in. Gamepad supported.
programs.note: Mac: Intel or Apple Silicon, macOS 11 or newer. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

programs.name: Till the Moon Bleeds
programs.description: Open-world voxel survival: mine and build on fully destructible terrain, craft, fight off zombies, and survive a blood-moon horde every 7th night. Gamepad supported.
programs.note: New in 0.14: a story with an ending, traders and townsfolk, and raider camps that keep watch and hold their walls. It's a .7z: Windows 11 opens it with Extract All; on Windows 10 use the free 7-Zip.

programs.name: Deadzone Arcade
programs.description: Top-down, wave-based zombie horde shooter: five objective types (clear, hold, hunt, path and blackout) plus a boss every fifth round, a points shop and stacking perks. Gamepad supported.
programs.note: Mac: Intel or Apple Silicon. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help). On an older computer, set Graphics quality to Low.

programs.name: I Blame The Wind
programs.description: Turn-based, Worms-style artillery game: destructible terrain, wind that bends every shot, 11 weapons and pixel-art scenery. Two players on one screen, gamepad supported.

programs.name: B.E.S.T. Scrolling Shooter
programs.description: Blast Everything in Space Time: a cyberpunk-fantasy scrolling shooter. 25 stages that swing between vertical and horizontal, 3D bosses that fly in through a wormhole, four ships, nine weapons that evolve, up to five weapon slots with cores, and a drone that levels up beside you. Boss Rush, Practice, and a second loop once you win. Keyboard, gamepad and touch.
programs.note: Plays in the browser too, on phones and tablets. Mac: pick Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help). Android: allow installs from unknown sources when asked; plays in portrait with touch or a gamepad.

programs.name: Music KID
programs.description: Scans a song and tells you its key, tempo and chords. Includes a play-along chord chart with guitar and piano shapes, batch scanning of folders, and fully offline operation.

images.alt: Music KID chord map of "B the Motivator - Roses and Candles": D minor, 83 BPM
Music KID play-along view of "B the Motivator - Roses and Candles"

programs.note: Mac: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) only, macOS 12 or newer. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

programs.name: NoBull Music Player
programs.description: A no-nonsense local music player for Windows and Android, built to handle a tagged music library and your own untagged bounces side by side. Plays MP3, FLAC, M4A, WMA, OGG, WAV and AIFF, with playlists and media keys.

programs.name: ANSA
programs.description: Serum-style wavetable synth built on Vital: arpeggiator, granular and multisample oscillators, two effect buses, 8 macros and 10 LFOs. VST3 plugin or standalone.

programs.name: DIG
programs.description: Sample librarian for music producers: scans your sample folders for type, BPM and key, auditions instantly, and drags straight into your DAW. Duplicates go to a quarantine folder, never deleted.

programs.name: Lightbox MV
programs.description: Frame-by-frame animated music videos, drawn on the beat. Add a song and it finds the tempo, every beat and the drum hits; drawings snap to bars and beats, loop as clips, and lip-sync to a voice track. Onion skin, layers and a video-editor layout.
programs.note: MP4 and GIF export need ffmpeg installed (winget install Gyan.FFmpeg).

programs.name: ZoomDraw
programs.description: Infinite-zoom drawing: strokes stay sharp at any depth. Loop mode turns your drawing into an endless tunnel you can export as a GIF.

programs.name: TileSmith
programs.description: Paint seamless patterns while you watch the live repeat. Draw across any edge and the stroke continues on the opposite side. Layers, fill, shapes and image import, with PNG export of one tile or a 3 × 3 sheet.
programs.note: Windows: unzip and run TileSmith.exe, keeping the folder together. It can also connect to Codex so AI can paint on the canvas (Windows only). Mac: pick Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

programs.name: Fractal Gen
programs.description: Living recursive kaleidoscope. Scroll to travel through it, and save what you like. Fully offline, with a flash limiter on by default.
programs.note: Mac: pick Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

programs.name: BEZ Planet Gen
programs.description: Generate a planet, walk around on it, and export it as a game asset: meshes, a Godot scene and a heightmap.
programs.note: Mac: Intel or Apple Silicon. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

programs.name: BEZ Planet Maze
programs.description: A maze wrapped around a planet. Walk it in first person or export it as a game asset.
programs.note: Mac: Intel or Apple Silicon. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

programs.name: B's E-Z Layout
programs.description: A simple drawing app for construction sketches: floor plans, site plans, framing layouts, and door and window details. Every size is in feet and inches, every sheet prints true to scale, and 388 ready-made templates cover doors, kitchens, electrical, framing and more. Made for people who have never used CAD.
programs.note: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. If Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway. Mac: pick Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

images.alt: A site and floor plan for a 3-bed house, drawn to scale with a title block
A front elevation of a house with roof, siding and stone labeled
The Templates library open with doors, windows, kitchen and bath pieces
A commercial site plan with a sales floor, offices and a 19-stall parking lot

programs.name: BEZ Pro Write
programs.description: A step-by-step coach for professional writing: emails, chat messages, memos, business letters, cover letters and short reports, built on the 7 C's. You type every word; it points out spots to look at and explains why, but never rewrites. The 7 C's check walks you through one spot at a time and outlines it in your writing. Practice mode with 16 scenarios, a progress page, export to Word, text or PDF, and Read it aloud with six natural voices. Fully offline, or try it in the browser.
programs.note: Mac: one download for Intel and Apple Silicon, macOS 11 or newer. The first time on macOS 15 or newer, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway; on macOS 11 to 14, right-click the app and choose Open.

images.alt: BEZ Pro Write pointing out spots in a sample email, with an explanation and a This one's fine button
The 7 C's check, starting with Complete, with readability and style scores
Practice mode: made-up writing situations in levels

programs.name: B's E-Z Read Me a Story
programs.description: Reads your documents aloud. Open a PDF, EPUB, Word, text or Markdown file, press Play, and follow along as the words light up. It remembers your place in every book and works offline with a built-in voice.
programs.note: Windows, 64-bit. The built-in voice is a one-time 320 MB download. If Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway. Mac: Apple Silicon only (M1 or newer), no Intel version. The first time, drag it to Applications and try to open it, then go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway, and confirm.

images.alt: B's E-Z Read Me a Story library with an EPUB, a PDF, a Word file and a text file
A story being read aloud, with the current sentence and word highlighted
Reader settings beside a story: text size, font and highlight options
The Appearance settings with light and dark color themes

programs.name: The Judge
programs.description: Fly through your 3D game assets, fully rendered, and sort each one by art style (Realistic, Low-poly, Voxel, Retro/PS1 and more). Verdicts save to CSV and JSON as you go.
programs.note: Mac: pick Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel. The first launch needs Open Anyway (see Install help).

programs.name: BEZ Launch
programs.description: Windows 11-style dark launcher for Android, built for the Galaxy Note 8 and S Pen.

programs.name: AI Workbench
programs.description: Scripts and docs for a fully local AI tool suite (coding, images, 3D, music, speech), with a Quick Launch app that runs one GPU tool at a time.
programs.note: Scripts and docs only. Install the AI apps and models yourself.

programs.name: revu
programs.description: Claude Code skill: reviews the document you just wrote and fixes its defects.
programs.note: Unzip into your Claude Code skills folder.

programs.name: game-studio
programs.description: Claude Code skill: a full studio simulation that takes a one-line idea to a shippable game.
programs.note: Unzip into your Claude Code skills folder.
